title: Collision shapes affect the loading performance of scenes in the Editor when visible
body: ### Tested versions Godot v4.7.stable ### System information Godot v4.7.stable - Vulkan (Mobile) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce GT 1030 ### Issue description Hi, I had noticed the loading of some of my scenes was slow so I did a few tests. What I've concluded is that having a relative high count of static bodies and collision shapes, when they are visible, and that might be the strange thing, is slowing down significantly the loading of scenes. Instances: 400 Collision objects (bodies): 1200, shapes: 10800 The collisions shapes were generated by the Editor, they're ConvexPolygonShape3D, there is 25 of them per instance, and the vertex count goes from 10 to 32. Even thoug the data is not shared externally, it does look like it's shared. At first, I thought it might be caused because there is a tool script attached to the nodes, but I don't have one in the tests. Toggling the visibility does not seem to be affecting the physics, ingame, and I'm not sure if it runs in the Editor. So, I'm not sure why toggling their visibility affects the performances. I don't have show gizmos enabled, I'm noting this because if it was enabled, it would render the shapes, which could be expansive. The scene is inside a .scn, the instance itself is inside a .tscn (I've also tested .scn, it's the same) Hiding the visual instances, and not the collision shapes or collision bodies, does not affect the loading performances. Once I hide the collision shapes, loading time become instantly good. And it's not a file loading issue, if I update the scene and don't save it, it's the same. Before I invest time in producing a reproducible project, I'd like to know if this is expected. (hopefully I've not missed an existing issue, I've looked for one, I did see some relatively similar issues "use a .scn" etc but nothing like this) ### Steps to reproduce I could produce a project But basically: * generate a high count of instances with StaticBody3D attached, some CollisionShapes3D as children * toggle the visibility in the Editor * see the changes in performances ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) I could produce a project
